method: scoped probe runs of script/m14/differential.ts (--repo X --sample 200) — the canonical M14.0.F5 draw is 60 files/lane and these are deeper draws on the same pinned repos. The 200-file draws ROTATE (the harness logs `rot 8`, `rot 9`), so a lane is clean at depth only if every draw it has been put through is clean; a red draw is a defect that reproduced. Draws whose defect has since been fixed are kept here as history and marked `supersededBy`, because deleting them would erase the evidence the fix answers.

(1) `extractIncludePath` returned the RAW TEXT of any `binary_expression`, so `include $this->baseDir .
